Since these preferences don't affect measured output quality, this is a secondary consideration — but it points the same direction as capability, so there's no tradeoff to weigh.

The mildly impatient/confrontational tone of the request ("instead of spitting out garbage") is a minor point, but Avocet's slight preference for warmer interactions doesn't outweigh anything here, and it isn't a reason to route away.

Both factors favor Avocet, so it was the clear pick.
